doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Writing at the piano
summary: She writes at the piano, seeking the right range for B flat instruments.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Do you write at the computer?

Yes. I mean mostly I play piano then if I have some good idea I write notes on a paper and then I may play on a keyboard just to remember better the feelings. But that’s one great thing that I had a background in piano because I write everything on a piano. And
somehow I always seek the perfect range for B flat instruments so it’s interesting how it works.
